description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 ne kompleksin Kino Block ne Porcelan.
Apartamenti organizohet ne 1 sallon ndenje dhe kuzhina, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkon.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 107.15 m2
Kompleks banimi dhe sherbimi i perbere nga 5 kulla. Ky projekt organizohet me hapesira te gjelberuara, rruge lidhese me ndertimet e reja. Gjithashtu prane eshte duke u zhvilluar edhe projekti i Ambienteve te sherbimit per Qender Shendetsore, Kopesht, Shkolla 9-Vjecare dhe e Mesme e sapo perfunduar. Zona aktualisht eshte ne faze zhvillimi si nga gjithe komplekset e reja qe po ndertohen, por dhe per shkak te unazes se madhe e cila ka fillur punimet dhe i shton vlere dhe akses levizje zones.
Per me shume informacion, kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Kino Block complex in Porcelan. The apartment is organized in 1 living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment has a total area of ​​107.15 m2. Residential and service complex consisting of 5 towers. This project is organized with green spaces, connecting roads with the new buildings. The service facilities project for the Health Center, Kindergarten, 9-Year-Old School and the newly completed High School is also being developed nearby. The area is currently in the development stage, like all the new complexes that are being built, but also because of the big ring which has started the works and adds value and access to the area. For more information, contact us!
